python -c "
import semver

# Test replace function
print('Testing replace function:')
result = semver.replace('1.2.3', major=2)
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3\", major=2) = {result!r}')

result = semver.replace('1.2.3-alpha+build', patch=5, prerelease='beta')
print(f'  replace(\"1.2.3-alpha+build\", patch=5, prerelease=\"beta\") = {result!r}')

# Test VersionInfo.replace method
print('\nTesting VersionInfo.replace method:')
v = semver.VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print(f'  Original: {v}')
result = v.replace(major=2)
print(f'  v.replace(major=2) = {result}')
print(f'  Original unchanged: {v}')

result = v.replace(patch=5, prerelease='beta')
print(f'  v.replace(patch=5, prerelease=\"beta\") = {result}')

# Test public names
print('\nTesting public names:')
print(f'  createparser: {semver.createparser}')
print(f'  main: {semver.main}')
print(f'  process: {semver.process}')

# Test that they work
parser = semver.createparser()
print(f'  Parser created: {parser}')

print('\nAll tests passed!')
"
